### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A21 and A22 appear in about 22% of traces instead of about 78% before; A23 and A24 appear in about 79–80% instead of about 22% before. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- The outgoing transitions of A20 shift from A21 (78% before, 21% after) to A23 (22% before, 78% after). [DIR001]
- Co-occurrence of A20 with A21/A22 drops from about 78% to about 21%, while co-occurrence of A20 with A23/A24 rises from about 22% to about 79%. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004]
- Co-occurrence of A21 with A22 drops from 78% to 21%, and co-occurrence of A23 with A24 rises from 22% to 79%. [REL005, REL012]
- Co-occurrence of A21/A22 with A28 drops from about 78% to about 21%, while co-occurrence of A23/A24 with A28 rises from about 22% to about 79%. [REL008, REL011, REL013, REL014]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The observed differences all reflect a single switch between two branches, which is not clearly more than the number expected by chance under a stable process.
